podcast.title: Documentary Soundtrack Contributor
podcast.body: Violet collaborated with her father and other notable musicians on a cover of X's "Nausea" for the soundtrack of Dave Grohl's touring documentary "What Drives Us." "Violet Girl and Father Dave, with help from some friends, that's nausea, a track that appeared on the soundtrack of Dave's documentary on touring called What Drives Us."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Stage Performances with Father
podcast.body: Dave Grohl has frequently invited his oldest daughter, Violet, to perform on stage with him for vocal collaborations. "Dave is brought as oldest of three daughters' violets on stage with him to sing on a number of occasions."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
